title: Crashed saucer from the 1940s and a secrecy pact between countries

tellings.quote: >> If we have a crash saucer from the ' 40s, I would say if we are in possession of it, and they're in possession of it, too, then there is an agreement between countries that says we're not going to talk about this.

plain: If the United States holds a crashed flying saucer from the 1940s, and another country holds one too, then the two countries would have an agreement not to talk about it. A researcher named Peter Levenda offers this to Michels as his own reasoning rather than a reported fact, to explain why no government has spoken out.
